display_title: Locked up With My Childhood Friend
description:
*Welcome to the room you can't leave before becoming a bitch.*

Woo Tae-Yun, with the highest trait of being an extreme right-wing alpha and the powerful title of successor to Hanseo Group, is kidnapped along with his childhood friend Do-Hyun one day and locked in a pristine white room. Is it for ransom? Or is it the work of a stalker of Woo Tae-Yun? Just as anxiety is growing, a mysterious message arrives on the cell phone in the middle of the room. The 'first mission' begins with a lighthearted drinking of each other's XX. It seems that they were not simply kidnapped, but captured by a pervert.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
